label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (sql-injection) alert-TP: User input 'param' from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') is directly concatenated into a SQL string 'q' on line 22 ('UPDATE accounts SET note='' + param + '''). The resolved sink value of 'q' is fully dependent on attacker-controlled input. Although execution occurs outside this method, the construction of the SQL payload creates a viable injection vector stored in pendingSql.

evidence.note: SQL string 'q' constructed by concatenating user input 'param' without sanitization
